pitfalls.symptom: Hardcoding plugin or MCP package lists in sync/bump scripts silently omits newly added components (e.g. ci-mcp / local-env-mcp stuck at 0.1.0)
pitfalls.bad_pattern: for pkg in sdd-forge-mcp; do bump "$pkg"; done
pitfalls.good_pattern: Auto-discover plugins/*/ and mcp/*/package.json; fail closed (exit 1/2) when a manifest or version is missing or mismatched

pitfalls.symptom: Duplicating rules or placing CLAUDE.md alongside AGENTS.md causes Context Clash and makes Claude Code v2.1.277+ ignore AGENTS.md
pitfalls.bad_pattern: Maintaining CLAUDE.md or symlinks alongside a 300+ line AGENTS.md
pitfalls.good_pattern: Keep root AGENTS.md <= 100 lines as an index, place domain details in subdirectory AGENTS.md, and prohibit CLAUDE.md across active directories

pitfalls.symptom: Silent test skips or empty catch blocks produce false-positive CI green runs
pitfalls.bad_pattern: if (!hasPwsh) return; // silently skip parity test
pitfalls.good_pattern: Fail closed when required verification tools are absent or run parity suites on a guaranteed runner

pitfalls.symptom: Manually editing generated artifacts (manifests, marketplaces, agent prompts) causes immediate SSOT drift
pitfalls.good_pattern: Edit the SSOT under plugins/*/plugin.manifest.json or contracts/agents/*.agent.yaml and run node scripts/sync-ssot.mjs

pitfalls.symptom: Detection test suites embed contiguous banned marker literals and become false-positive hits of their own gate
pitfalls.good_pattern: Assemble scanned marker tokens dynamically at runtime (e.g. ['T','O','D','O'].join(''))

pitfalls.symptom: Spawning .cmd/.bat shims via execFile(..., { shell: false }) fails on Windows Node.js >= 20.12
pitfalls.good_pattern: Resolve explicit executable or invoke Node directly via process.execPath without batch wrappers

pitfalls.symptom: Mixing node:fs / process.env side effects into pure readonly core modules breaks MCP no-write guarantees
pitfalls.bad_pattern: Importing node:fs or reading process.env inside v2-readonly-core
pitfalls.good_pattern: Inject readonly IO adapters via parameters and keep pure core free of fs/env/child_process imports

pitfalls.symptom: Comparing process.argv[1] to import.meta.url without realpathSync skips CLI main() when launched through symlinks
Omitting relative ESM extensions or narrowing JSON with `as` bypasses runtime validation
pitfalls.bad_pattern: import { foo } from './bar'; const data = JSON.parse(raw) as Config;
pitfalls.good_pattern: Always specify explicit ESM extensions and validate unknown parsed JSON before narrowing

pitfalls.symptom: Using case-insensitive -eq/-match in .ps1 ports accepts mis-cased inputs that POSIX .sh rejects
pitfalls.good_pattern: Use -ceq / -cmatch / [StringComparer]::Ordinal and include a mis-cased negative test per layer

pitfalls.symptom: PowerShell unrolls single-element arrays and ignores native command failures without explicit $LASTEXITCODE checks
pitfalls.good_pattern: Wrap collections with @(...) and assert $LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 alongside $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

pitfalls.symptom: GNU `sed -i` fails on macOS BSD sed and unquoted variables break on paths containing spaces
pitfalls.good_pattern: Use Node.js ESM (`scripts/sync-ssot.mjs`) for file transformations and always quote "$var" with `set -euo pipefail`

pitfalls.symptom: Using subprocess(..., shell=True) enables command injection and omitting encoding='utf-8' corrupts non-ASCII files on Windows
pitfalls.good_pattern: Pass argv arrays with shell=False and always specify encoding='utf-8'
